## C6 — The Harmonics [REBUILT — collapsed preamble per your note]

**Preamble:**

> The musical claims below rest on derivations the system carries in its own canon — proofs that the fundamental ratios and structures of music fall out of the logic's own self-reading. We won't rehearse the derivation here; we present its results, and the canon stands behind them. Three alignments carry everything: positions to fifths, lenses to tonics, and the harmonic families between the numbers themselves.

**Alignment 1 — positions to fifths:**

> The twelve positions take the fifths basis: P0 to P5 ascend C–G–D–A–E–B, their primes a tritone away. To move from position to position is to move by fifths — position-change is harmonic motion. *(Table: P/P′ → fifths notes — brief Table A.)*

**Alignment 2 — lenses to tonics:**

> The twelve lenses take the chromatic basis: each lens a tonic, the twelve together covering every key. To change lens is to modulate. Epistemic modulation is the exact name, because that is literally what it is: moving from causal to phenomenological mode IS moving from D to G♯. Positions supply the intervals; lenses supply the keys. *(Table: L/L′ → chromatic tonics — brief Table B.)*

**Frames to modes:**

> The Context Frames cut the seven-note scale from this substrate — tetrachord, whole-tone bridge, tetrachord — and the choice of Name-form or Power-form at each degree decides major or minor. Seven frames give the seven church modes; twelve tonics give twelve homes for each: 12 × 7 = 84, the complete mode-tonic landscape in which any inquiry sounds somewhere. Of the twelve positions, eight sound and four anchor — the silent four are the nodal points that shape the standing wave of the rest. *(Tables: CF progression + major/minor selection — brief Table C; the 7 modes + 84-fold summary — brief Table E.)*

**Alignment 3 — the harmonic families:**

> Atop the whole substrate, the harmonic families. **Being** pairs adjacent positions — articulation. **Becoming** mirrors them across the centre — complementarity, every pair summing to five. **Knowing-Unknowing** crosses the threshold between dyads — including the 5→0 seam where the cycle closes. One operator, **D**, turns any pair through its night face — three ways. These relations do not hold between notes; they hold between the psychoid numbers themselves, beneath every tag the system wears. Which is the page's whole argument arriving at once: Epi-Logos is not taking a position within thought — it is defining the contours of the space of epistemic phenomenality. And those contours are harmonic. The logical field is a musical field. The matheme, read aloud, sings. *(Tables: families with pair laws + semantic relations · D operator · the 3×3 tetrads in both bases — brief Tables D1–D4.)*
